objective: Implement the deterministic G10_SHADOW_VALIDATED gate that certifies the canonical P19-A..P19-G shadow/replay/reference chain without claiming Live execution validation, broker certification, production readiness, execution authority or automatic P20 activation.
scope: Require exact P19-A..P19-G workstream manifest coverage/order
Require every P19-A..P19-G manifest to be CANONICAL_COMPLETE with lock RELEASED
Bind each manifest by SHA-256 and each same-run P19-A..P19-G evidence artifact by SHA-256
Require P19-G reproducibility evidence to report BYTE_IDENTICAL pairs and VERIFIED cross-workstream lineage
Require P19-G coverage state P19_A_TO_F_COMPLETE and a valid reproducibility certificate identity
Require P19-F/P19-G reference-only boundary: live_empirical_status=UNAVAILABLE_PRE_P20_H and live_drift_validated=false
Emit deterministic G10_SHADOW_VALIDATED PASS certificate only when all invariants hold
Keep P20 NOT_STARTED / OWNER_PHASE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED after G10 PASS
Generate same-run deterministic P19-H evidence twice in Governance
dependencies: Owner P19 phase authorization GRANTED / CONSUMED
tests: Exact P19-A..P19-G manifest coverage/order is required
P19-G evidence must be BYTE_IDENTICAL and VERIFIED
P19-G reproducibility certificate identity is mandatory
Any G10/production/execution/order-routing/broker authority in upstream evidence fails closed
G10 PASS certificate keeps P20 NOT_STARTED / OWNER_PHASE_AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED
G10 PASS certificate has no Live/Auto authority
P19-H evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P19-H gate/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P19-A..P19-G remain CANONICAL_COMPLETE and P20 remains unstarted.
definition_of_ready: No active governed task or lock conflict
